what:
## What
aivlc is a backend-agnostic engine (plus a thin CLI) that runs the AI SDLC pipeline's workflow -- its stage DAG, deterministic Python spine, and adversarial review structure -- driven by pluggable AI backends. Any pipeline stage/role can be routed to a different, configurable backend+model (e.g. design-slice -> Gemini, build-slice -> claude -p, code-review -> Ollama-cloud GLM), so the operator mixes strong models for adversarial reasoning with cheap/local models for mechanical work. Backends: Ollama (local + cloud), claude -p (Claude Code CLI), Claude API, Google Gemini, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity (CLI/SDK).

Out of scope (now): full-pipeline parity up front -- start with a minimal core loop and add stages as slices. Deferred but not ruled out: a GUI/dashboard, model hosting/training, and general-agent-framework generality.
non_goals: full-pipeline parity up front (reimplementing all 25+ stages / 12 agents before a usable core ships)

actors.name: operator
actors.role: developer running aivlc to build their own software project; also configures backends
top_actions: drive pipeline stages to build a project
answer the human-in-the-loop gates (mode, plan approval, Critic triage, candidate pick)
needs: schema-valid artifacts regardless of which backend produced them
faithful control flow (auto-advance vs halt gates, resume after interruption)
visibility into what each backend/agent did and its cost
cannot: bypass the reality gates (the trust spine is enforced)
rely on a GUI (v1 is CLI + importable library)
assume all backends exist on day one (pluggable, added incrementally)

stack.choice: Python 3.13+ -- vendor the reference MIT spine (scripts/lib) behind a harness-shim; reuse agent personas + JSON schemas
Engine + thin CLI (library-first core; CLI frontend also supplies the human-in-the-loop channel)
Per-stage / per-role backend routing as a first-class configurable surface

constraints.infra: Local cross-platform dev tool (Windows primary), pip-installable. Depends on external backends being present (claude CLI, Ollama server local/cloud, Anthropic / OpenAI / Gemini SDKs, Antigravity CLI/SDK). Vault state lives in the reference's external hash-keyed store.
constraints.team: Solo developer, Python-fluent; open-ended timeline; incremental vertical slices.

references.label: AI SDLC reference pipeline (primary spec, READ-ONLY, MIT, same owner)
